topic: Restarting an old debt's statute of limitations vs disputing it (Gabe vs Tessa)

scenes.narration: One phone call restarted a seven year old debt's clock to zero. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a giant calendar with a SEVEN YEAR clock snapping back to ZERO, comic burst banner reads CLOCK RESET, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gabe and Tessa each get a call about a six year old debt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man gabe and woman tessa each answering a phone, a debt collector envelope stamped SIX YEARS OLD between them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: In their state, old debt becomes uncollectable in court after seven years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing law book open to a page titled STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS SEVEN YEARS, a wooden gavel resting on it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The collector pressures Gabe into one small good faith payment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a phone screen showing a pushy collector, man gabe looking unsure holding a credit card, comic banner reads JUST ONE PAYMENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That single payment legally restarts the seven year clock from zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gabe tapping a small payment on a phone, a huge clock behind him spinning back to ZERO, comic banner reads CLOCK RESTARTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tessa asks for the debt's age and original creditor in writing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman tessa at a desk writing a letter, a form labeled DEBT VALIDATION REQUEST, a calendar showing the debt's age, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She learns the debt sits past her state's statute of limitations.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman tessa reading a document with a highlighted line reading PAST STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS, relief on her face, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tessa sends a dispute letter and never admits the debt is hers.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman tessa mailing a sealed envelope stamped DISPUTE, a sticky note beside her reads NEVER ADMIT THE DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gabe gets sued and loses because his payment revived the debt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gabe standing in a courtroom looking shocked, official paperwork stamped JUDGMENT on the bench, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His wages get garnished for a debt that should have expired.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a sad man gabe holding a paycheck with a chunk torn away labeled GARNISHED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tessa owes nothing and the collector closes her file for good.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman tessa smiling as a collector closes a file folder stamped CLOSED, a note beside her reads ZERO OWED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Never pay or admit an old debt before checking the statute. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads CHECK THE STATUTE FIRST, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
